title: What Do Women Find Attractive in Men? 20 Traits That Matter
h1: What Do Women Find Attractive in Men? 20 Traits That Matter More Than You Think
description: What do women find attractive in men? From humor and kindness to style, confidence and emotional presence, here are 20 traits many women appreciate.
keyword: what do women find attractive in men
excerpt: Humor, kindness, emotional presence, a bit of style and a lot of confidence. Twenty traits many women find attractive, and how to build them.
intro:
Ask a dozen women what they find attractive in men and you'll get a dozen different answers. Some love tall guys; others couldn't care less about height. Some swoon over a beard; others prefer clean-shaven. Attraction is personal, and that's good news, because it means there's no single mold you need to fit.

Still, certain traits come up again and again when women describe what draws them to someone. Most of them have nothing to do with genetics and everything to do with how you treat people, how you carry yourself and how you show up. Here are 20 of them, grouped into personality, presence, lifestyle and looks, plus practical ways to lean into each one.
body:
First, attraction isn't one-size-fits-all

Before the list, a reminder: every woman is an individual. Her preferences are shaped by her personality, experiences, culture and what she's looking for at that moment in life. Physical attraction matters, but for many women it's intertwined with how someone makes them feel. A man who seemed 'just okay' at first glance can become incredibly attractive once she sees his kindness or humor.

So read this as a guide to traits that are widely appreciated, not a checklist. The best version of you is always more attractive than an imitation of someone else.

Personality traits women find attractive

1. A good sense of humor

Being able to make someone laugh, and laugh at yourself, is consistently one of the most appealing traits. Humor signals intelligence, playfulness and the ability to handle life's ups and downs. You don't need to be a comedian. Being quick to smile and enjoying silly moments together goes a long way.

2. Kindness

How you treat servers, strangers, animals and your friends says a lot about you. Genuine kindness is attractive because it hints at how you'll treat a partner on a hard day.

3. Emotional presence

Being emotionally available, able to talk about feelings, listen without judgment and show up when things get tough, is deeply attractive. It means she can be herself with you. If opening up feels hard, start small: share how your day actually felt, not just what happened.

4. Curiosity and good conversation

Don't be afraid of conversation. Asking thoughtful questions and actually listening to the answers makes people feel valued. Our list of great questions to ask a girl can help you get started.

5. Passion for something

Whether it's coding, cooking, rock climbing or comic books, a man who lights up when talking about his interests is magnetic. Proudly geeking out about what you love is far more appealing than pretending to be too cool to care.

Tip: When you talk about your passions, invite her in. Ask what she's passionate about too, or offer to show her what you love. Enthusiasm is most attractive when it's shared.

Presence and confidence

6. Quiet confidence

Confidence isn't loudness or bravado. It's being comfortable in your own skin, making decisions, owning your mistakes and not needing constant approval. A secure man is relaxing to be around.

7. Endearing shyness

Confidence and shyness aren't opposites. Many women find a bit of shyness charming, especially when it comes with warmth and sincerity. A quiet guy who clearly cares often stands out among people trying too hard to impress.

8. Steady eye contact

Holding comfortable eye contact while you talk shows interest and self-assurance. It doesn't mean staring; it means being present in the conversation rather than glancing at your phone.

9. Calm, unhurried movements

People who move and speak at a relaxed pace tend to come across as composed and self-assured. Nervous fidgeting is normal, but slowing down a little, taking a breath before answering and not rushing your words can make you seem more at ease.

10. Good hugs and welcome affection

A warm, genuine hug can say more than words. Many women love a partner who's affectionate in ways that feel natural, always paying attention to whether that affection is welcome. Our guide on how to hug a girl covers how to read the moment.

Lifestyle and character

11. A sense of adventure

Being open to new experiences, whether that's travel, trying a new cuisine or signing up for a dance class, makes life with you sound fun. Adventure doesn't have to be extreme; it's about curiosity and saying yes to new things.

12. Cooking skills

A man who can cook a good meal, or is happily learning, shows self-sufficiency and care. Cooking for someone is also one of the most thoughtful ways to show affection.

13. Love for animals

Many women find a guy who's gentle and caring with a dog or cat incredibly sweet. It suggests patience, responsibility and a nurturing side. Of course, only get a pet if you're ready to take care of one.

14. Ambition and direction

Having goals, whatever they are, and working toward them is attractive. It's not about income; it's about drive, responsibility and enthusiasm for your future.

15. Respect for her independence

Supporting her career, friendships and goals, rather than feeling threatened by them, is a strong signal of maturity. Many women value a partner who treats them as an equal.

Looks and style

16. Good grooming

You don't need to be a model, but basic grooming makes a big difference: clean hair, trimmed nails, fresh breath and a well-kept beard or clean shave. It shows you take care of yourself.

17. Clothes that fit, and thoughtful details

Well-fitting clothes look better than expensive clothes that don't fit. Little details count too. Fun socks, a nice watch or a signature jacket can show personality and attention to detail.

18. Strong, capable hands and forearms

Plenty of women say they notice a man's hands and forearms, perhaps because they suggest capability and strength. Rolling up your sleeves isn't a magic trick, but keeping your hands well cared for is an easy win.

19. Being comfortable in your body

Tall or short, slim or broad, chest hair or no chest hair, freckles, a bit of a belly, a soft laugh: there are women who find every one of these attractive. What helps most is being comfortable with yourself. Height and build get talked about a lot, but many women care far more about how you carry yourself.

20. Aging with confidence

Gray hair, laugh lines and a few extra years can be very attractive when they come with confidence and self-care. The so-called 'silver fox' appeal is really about a man who's comfortable with who he is at every age.

How to become more attractive, practically

Most of these traits can be developed. A few starting points:

  • Invest in your health. Move your body, sleep well and eat reasonably. You'll feel better and look more energized.
  • Upgrade your grooming and wardrobe. A good haircut and a few well-fitting basics make an outsized difference.
  • Practice listening. Ask questions and follow up. It's a skill that improves with practice.
  • Pursue your interests. Passion and stories come from living a full life.
  • Work on emotional openness. Journaling, talking with friends or seeing a licensed therapist can help you understand and share your feelings more easily.

For more, see our guides on how to attract women and how to impress her.

Tip: Pick one trait from this list to focus on this month, like cooking a new meal each week or asking more follow-up questions. Small, consistent changes stick better than an overnight makeover.

What tends to be a turn-off

Just as some traits draw people in, others push them away. Common turn-offs include arrogance, rudeness to others, constant phone checking, talking only about yourself, poor hygiene and ignoring boundaries. Avoiding these is often as important as building positive traits.

The bottom line

So, what do women find attractive in men? Mostly, things you can develop: humor, kindness, emotional presence, curiosity, confidence and a life you're excited about, plus some care for how you present yourself. Physical preferences vary widely, but character and how you make someone feel tend to matter most. Focus on becoming the best version of yourself, and you'll naturally attract people who appreciate exactly who you are. Explore more in our relationships section, or have some fun with sweet pick up lines.
takeaways: Attraction is personal; there's no single ideal type.
Humor, kindness and emotional presence are widely appreciated.
Quiet confidence, eye contact and good listening make a strong impression.
Grooming and well-fitting clothes matter more than expensive style.
Most attractive traits can be developed with small, consistent effort.

faq.q: What physical features do women find attractive in men?
faq.a: Preferences vary widely, but many women mention a warm smile, expressive eyes, good posture, well-groomed hair or beard and clothes that fit well. Some notice hands and forearms. Height and build matter to some women and not at all to others. Confidence and self-care often influence physical attraction more than any single feature.

faq.q: What personality traits do women find most attractive?
faq.a: Commonly valued traits include a good sense of humor, kindness, emotional availability, confidence without arrogance, curiosity and passion for something. Many women also appreciate reliability, respect for their independence and good listening skills. These traits shape how a partner makes someone feel, which is a big part of attraction.

For some women it does, and for many it doesn't. Height preferences are personal and often matter less in real life than on dating profiles. How you carry yourself, your confidence and your personality usually make a bigger impression. Good posture and being comfortable in your body help at any height.

faq.q: How can a man become more attractive?
faq.a: Focus on what you can control: take care of your health and grooming, wear clothes that fit, develop interests you're passionate about, practice listening and asking questions, and work on being emotionally open. Treat everyone with kindness. Small, consistent improvements build both confidence and attractiveness over time.
